messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back. If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired. The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order. The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software. After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested. If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="ComputerRepairProcess" name="Computer Repair Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Customer brings in defective computer">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="CRS checks defect and calculates cost">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostDecision" name="Costs acceptable?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Unrepaired" name="Customer takes computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelStart" name="Start Parallel Repairs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    
    <!-- Hardware Branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HardwareRepair" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test system functionality (Hardware)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HardwareResult" name="Error detected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareRetry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HardwareDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArbitraryRepairHardware" name="Execute arbitrary repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareRetry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BackToHardwareRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Software Branch -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SoftwareConfig" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality (Software)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DecisionSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SoftwareResult" name="Error detected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DecisionSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareRetry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SoftwareDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ArbitraryRepairSoftware" name="Execute arbitrary repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareRetry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BackToSoftwareConfig</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Merge Point -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelEnd" name="Wait for both repairs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HardwareDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SoftwareDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Finalize</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Repaired" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Finalize</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Gateway_CostDecision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Unrepaired" />
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_HardwareRepair" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestHardware" sourceRef="Task_HardwareRepair" targetRef="Task_TestHardware" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionHardware" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_HardwareResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareRetry" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_HardwareResult" targetRef="Task_ArbitraryRepairHardware" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BackToHardwareRepair" sourceRef="Task_ArbitraryRepairHardware" targetRef="Task_HardwareRepair" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HardwareDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_HardwareResult" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelStart" targetRef="Task_SoftwareConfig" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestSoftware" sourceRef="Task_SoftwareConfig" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionSoftware" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_SoftwareResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareRetry" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SoftwareResult" targetRef="Task_ArbitraryRepairSoftware" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BackToSoftwareConfig" sourceRef="Task_ArbitraryRepairSoftware" targetRef="Task_SoftwareConfig" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SoftwareDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SoftwareResult" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Finalize" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelEnd" targetRef="EndEvent_Repaired" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
